name: zutil_save_game_state_free_owned_resources
description: zUtil_SaveGameState::FreeOwnedResources clears network back-references, frees owned modal states, clears the primary modal pointer, and frees the player state.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
